A '''copper dolabra''' is a [[dolabra]] of the [[Copper equipment|copper]] tier, a pickaxe and axe in one tool. It is crafted from [[copper ingot]]s and sticks.

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}

== Usage ==

=== Mining ===
The copper dolabra breaks both pickaxe and axe blocks at speed 5, one slower than the [[copper pickaxe]] or [[copper axe]], and has 350 durability.

Its harvesting rules differ from the copper pickaxe's. It gets no drops from diamond ore (which it breaks at speed 4) or from [[sulfurous quartz deposit]]s and [[sulfur deposit]]s, but it harvests [[native gold]] and obsidian, which the copper pickaxe cannot.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/copper_dolabra.json}}</ref> This makes it the only copper tool that can mine obsidian.

Matcha Flavoured adds beds, candles, cacti and honeycomb blocks to the blocks that axes break quickly.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/block/mineable/axe.json}}</ref>

=== Combat ===
It deals {{Hp|5}} damage at an attack speed of 0.8.

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[copper ingot]]s. As with all equipment in the pack, the repair cost never grows, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting and smithing ===
{{Uses}}

In a [[blast furnace]] it melts down into a copper ingot. It uses the copper axe's item ID, so it also works as the base of the shakudo and hepatizon axe and dolabra smithing recipes.

== Notes ==
* The 1.12.1-alpha notes say only diamond, electrum and adamant tools can mine obsidian, but the copper dolabra's rules still harvest it.
